# Plants one shape per CASE for gpu-runtime-carrier-cases; nothing is built.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(pulp_gpu_runtime_carrier_fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
include("${CARRIERS_MODULE}")
set(PULP_BENCHMARK OFF)
set(_unit "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/unit.cpp")
if(CASE MATCHES "^gpu-runtime-")
    # The two direct carriers the check expects in gpu-runtime mode.
    add_library(fixture-device-api INTERFACE)
    add_library(VellumGpuRuntime::DeviceApi ALIAS fixture-device-api)
    foreach(_carrier fixture-platform fixture-gpu-device-api)
        add_library(${_carrier} INTERFACE)
        target_compile_definitions(${_carrier} INTERFACE PULP_GPU_RUNTIME=1)
        set_property(TARGET ${_carrier} APPEND PROPERTY INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES VellumGpuRuntime::DeviceApi)
    endforeach()
endif()
if(CASE STREQUAL "object-check")
    add_library(bench OBJECT ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "static-check")
    add_library(bench STATIC ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "static-zero")
    add_library(bench STATIC ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK=0)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "static-option")
    add_library(bench STATIC ${_unit})
    target_compile_options(bench PRIVATE -DPULP_BENCHMARK)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "generator-expression")
    add_library(bench OBJECT ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE $<$<CONFIG:Release>:PULP_BENCHMARK>)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "interface")
    add_library(bench INTERFACE)
    target_compile_definitions(bench INTERFACE PULP_BENCHMARK)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "linked")
    add_library(bench OBJECT ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK)
    add_executable(consumer ${_unit})
    target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE bench)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "objects")
    add_library(bench OBJECT ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK)
    add_executable(consumer ${_unit} $<TARGET_OBJECTS:bench>)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "gpu-runtime-without-flavour")
    add_library(bench OBJECT ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "gpu-runtime-with-flavour")
    add_library(bench OBJECT ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK GPU_RUNTIME_BENCHMARK=1)
elseif(CASE STREQUAL "gpu-runtime-zero-flavour")
    add_library(bench OBJECT ${_unit})
    target_compile_definitions(bench PRIVATE PULP_BENCHMARK GPU_RUNTIME_BENCHMARK=0)
elseif(NOT CASE STREQUAL "empty")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "unknown CASE ${CASE}")
endif()
pulp_gpu_runtime_write_carriers("${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/gpu-runtime-carriers.txt")
